summary: @servicetitan/forge preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: This package, advertised as a React UI component library, declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. The `setup.mjs` wrapper is itself obfuscated in obfuscator.io style (dictionary-keyed method dispatch, `_0x`-prefixed identifiers, indirection functions) and downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun bun-v1.3.13) into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it via `execFileSync` to run the adjacent `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with obfuscator.io-style protection: a shuffled mixed number/string array rotated by a `WV8StW` function, `_0x`-style identifiers, and character-code reassembly via `String.fromCodePoint`. The delivery chain — fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time solely to execute an opaque, heavily obfuscated bundle under a package name that has no legitimate need for either — is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape and executes attacker-supplied code on the installer's machine at `npm install` time. Obfuscation extends to both the preinstall wrapper and the executed payload, blocking Node-focused scanners from inspecting the behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
